# event-schema-lint

Validate event schemas before the first consumer breaks.

## What it does

Checks event schema files (JSON, YAML, Avro) for:
- Required fields (event_id, timestamp, source, type)
- Version field for backward compatibility
- Idempotency key for at-least-once delivery
- Event naming convention (lowercase, dotted, past tense)
- Documentation field

## Key files

- event_schema_lint.py: main CLI tool, manual sys.argv parsing
- test_event_schema_lint.py: 9 tests

## CLI usage

    python event_schema_lint.py <directory> [--report] [--json]

## Flags

- <directory>: path to scan
- --report: one paste-ready summary line
- --json: machine-readable output

## Supported formats

- JSON Schema (.json)
- Avro (.avsc)
- YAML (.yaml, .yml)

## Exit codes

- 0: no errors
- 1: errors found
- 2: bad path

## Design patterns

- Zero dependencies (stdlib only)
- Single file (event_schema_lint.py)
- MIT license
- --report mode for paste-ready output
- Exit code 0/1 for CI integration
